sig: [[["A", "Hi, Peter? It's Nina from Finance. I'm calling about your expense report for the Singapore trip."], ["B", "Oh, hi Nina. Is there a problem?"], ["A", "I'm afraid it's been rejected. Two receipts are missing: the taxi from the airport and one hotel dinner."], ["B", "Ah, the taxi driver didn't give me one. But I should have the dinner receipt somewhere."], ["A", "OK. For the taxi, you can fill in a missing-receipt form, as long as it's under fifty dollars."], ["B", "It was about thirty-five, so that's fine."], ["A", "Great. Just send everything back to me by Wednesday."], ["B", "And when would I get paid?"], ["A", "If I get it by then, the money will go out with payroll on the twenty-fifth."], ["B", "That's a relief. Things are a bit tight this month."], ["A", "I understand. I'll keep an eye out for your email."]], {"A": "F-US", "B": "M-GB"}]
